hero.title: Discover London Your Way
hero.description: Explore London through one simple travel website. Discover famous landmarks, hidden corners, cultural experiences, food, shopping, nightlife and carefully planned travel ideas for your next adventure.

website.title: More Than Just a London Travel Guide
website.paragraph1: Explore London is a travel website designed to make discovering London easier, more organised and more enjoyable. Instead of searching through different websites for attractions, experiences and travel ideas, visitors can explore everything in one place.
website.paragraph2: The website brings together London's famous landmarks, interesting places, travel packages, galleries and useful information in a clean and easy-to-use experience. Every section is designed to help visitors decide what they want to see, where they want to go and how they can make the most of their time in London.
website.paragraph3: Whether you are visiting London for the first time, planning a short weekend or returning to discover something new, Explore London gives you inspiration to create a journey that matches your interests.
website.highlightDescription: Discover the landmarks, streets, culture and experiences that make London one of the world's most fascinating cities.

london.title: A City Where History Meets Modern Life
london.paragraph1: London is one of the world's most recognisable cities, known for its historic landmarks, royal connections, museums, theatres, diverse neighbourhoods and vibrant city life. The city brings together centuries of history and a constantly changing modern culture.
london.paragraph2: From the River Thames and historic Westminster to colourful markets, peaceful parks and busy shopping streets, London offers a huge variety of places to explore. Every neighbourhood has its own character, food, architecture and stories.
london.paragraph3: London is also a city for different kinds of travellers. History lovers can explore centuries-old buildings and museums, food lovers can experience cuisines from around the world, while shoppers, photographers, art lovers and nightlife enthusiasts can all find something to enjoy.
